tasks.label: Build mini-mbm (Linux Debug)
tasks.command: mkdir -p build/linux_debug && cd build/linux_debug && cmake ../.. -DPLAT=Linux -DUSE_ALL=1 -DMBM_ENABLE_MESH_LEGACY_V7=1 -DAUDIO=audiere -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && make -j$(nproc)

tasks.label: Build mini-mbm (Linux Release)
tasks.command: mkdir -p build/linux_release && cd build/linux_release && cmake ../.. -DPLAT=Linux -DUSE_ALL=1 -DMBM_ENABLE_MESH_LEGACY_V7=1 -DAUDIO=audiere -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make -j$(nproc)

tasks.label: Build mini-mbm (macOS Debug)
tasks.command: mkdir -p build/macos_debug && cd build/macos_debug && cmake ../.. -DPLAT=MacOs -DUSE_ALL=1 -DMBM_ENABLE_MESH_LEGACY_V7=1 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && make -j$(sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu)

tasks.label: Build mini-mbm (macOS Release)
tasks.command: mkdir -p build/macos_release && cd build/macos_release && cmake ../.. -DPLAT=MacOs -DUSE_ALL=1 -DMBM_ENABLE_MESH_LEGACY_V7=1 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make -j$(sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu)

tasks.label: Build mini-mbm (Windows MinGW Debug)
tasks.command: if not exist build\mingw_debug mkdir build\mingw_debug && cd build\mingw_debug && cmake ../.. -G "MinGW Makefiles" -DPLAT=Windows -DUSE_ALL=1 -DMBM_ENABLE_MESH_LEGACY_V7=1 -DAUDIO=audiere -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && mingw32-make -j%NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS%

tasks.label: Build mini-mbm (Windows MinGW Release)
tasks.command: if not exist build\mingw_release mkdir build\mingw_release && cd build\mingw_release && cmake ../.. -G "MinGW Makefiles" -DPLAT=Windows -DUSE_ALL=1 -DMBM_ENABLE_MESH_LEGACY_V7=1 -DAUDIO=audiere -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && mingw32-make -j%NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS%
